statement: On Raynaud's surface S over an algebraically closed field of characteristic 2, with the data of his Remarque 3, Q = O_S(2T) (x) f*N is ample and globally generated, h^0(Q) = 6, h^1(Q^-1) = 1, H^1(Q^-n) = 0 for n >= 2, and h^1(O_S) = 9.

Let X be smooth projective connected over an algebraically closed field of characteristic p >= 0, Q generated by its sections with Q^m very ample for some m >= 2 prime to p. Adjoining m-th roots of a general basis of H^0(X, Q^m) gives a smooth projective connected Y on which L = rho*Q is very ample, and H^i(Y, L^-1) is the direct sum of the H^i(X, Q^(-1-r_1-...-r_l)) over 0 <= r_j <= m-1.

Over every algebraically closed field of characteristic 2 there is a smooth projective connected surface Y, finite and flat of degree 9^556 over S, with a very ample line bundle L such that h^0(L) = 562, h^1(L^-1) = 1 and h^1(O_Y) = 565; for every smooth connected H in |L| the kernel of Pic_Y -> Pic_H has a one-dimensional tangent space at the identity.
Q^9 is very ample on S, and h^0(S, Q^9) = 210 + 186 + 160 = 556.
